stage: M3.1 chicken head (owner's idea, before M4)
parameter: gaze reflex on the bot's head commands (adaptive LMS counter-swing, gaze.py; phase compensation per axis chosen on train-0000..0003/0010..0015)
metric: camera wobble on train-0020..0025 (m3_gaze.py) and bot success on train 60 + all dev (750 episodes)
chosen: off for the bot and the M4 demos; gaze.py kept as an option
result: camera wobble while walking 6.0 -> 3.9 deg yaw, 5.0 -> 3.7 deg pitch (steering 7.6 -> 2.2 deg); but bot successes 678 -> 667 of 750 (set_lamp 216 -> 208), falls 0 -> 3, slower (go_and_return median 52 -> 56 s). The bot already corrects for head wobble with its camera model, so steadier frames buy it nothing, and swinging a head that is 38% of the body's mass costs balance.
